# Public RSA Challenge N Values Through RSA-260

This note records public RSA Challenge moduli only. It intentionally omits factors, factorization metadata, and solver-facing hints.

The list stops at RSA-260, the first unsolved modulus in this local ladder note. RSA-260 is a 260-decimal-digit, 862-bit RSA Challenge modulus.
